reason: Places KIND lowercasing in vCardFileToVCards raw output; requirement targets mapped contact data, a separate observation point, so no real conflict.
Names v0.8.5 as the Fortinet release; v0.8.5 dates to Jul 24, 2023 and Fortinet support arrived in v0.10.0 (Dec 2023).
UnstableValue.name returns the unstable 'org.matrix.msc2965.authentication'; the stable 'm.authentication' comes from altName.
i18n tests check PO entries and plural translation; missing-string detection is done by scripts/detect_missing_i18n.py, which tests never invoke.
Go requires a local replacement's go.mod to match the module path; it declares no release version needing compatibility.
IDelegatedAuthConfig sits under the unstable key 'org.matrix.msc2965.authentication'; indexing 'm.authentication' hits the any index signature instead.
No stateDirectory or meta.state_directory exists; MetaConfig only defines CheckForUpdates with key meta.check_for_updates.
Copied sentinel checks omit handling for omitted min/max; undefined passes both !== tests, yielding null-valued $gte/$lte filters instead of total count.
Pattern holds for get_subjects.py and parse.py, but importapi passes read_fields results to get_subfield without decode_field.
lending_edition drives borrow results and URLs, but lending-library filtering uses the lending_library facet, public_scan_b, borrowed_b and year range.
Helper on post-default service.Config lacks presence info to detect an omitted kube address; needs FileConfig or a flag. Doubt: Enabled flag may suffice.
Generalizes from an https example; the http-prefix alternative would rewrite other schemes like ftp://, so not both satisfy requirement 12.
No remote peer is true, but a configured AdvertiseIP reaches auth via heartbeat and UpsertNode, so 'can't know' holds only without it.
Scope also covers the compat/selinux shim, payload inclusion, and respawn handling in test modules like sefcontext.py and selogin.py.
Sufficiency holds only without chat delay or reputation threshold, since earlier checks throw other errors. Doubt: those orthogonal checks seem outside the requirement.
Attributes 5 to single-key zcount, which yields 3 for sortedSetTest1. Doubt: agent clearly meant the multi-key sum test expecting 5.
Subsonic 1.16.1 getShares returns shares the user is allowed to manage; the agent misquotes it as shares created by the user.
Offline resolution depends on whether a version is cached, not on differing; a different pseudo-version resolves offline if present in the module cache.
Finite-score premise fails generally: Redis sortedSetIncrBy forwards '+inf' to ZINCRBY, which can store infinite scores.
The chunk matched the 'VerifiedBadge' component name; the hyphenated 'verified-badge' SVG import appears only in the source map.
Lists suffix and stem, which Python 3.8's zipfile.Path (the supported runtime) lacks; they arrived in later versions.
Python 3.8 is_dir only tests the path string ('not at or endswith /'); no archive lookup can raise KeyError.
AutomaticEnv returns nothing; the later env lookup yields '2m'. Doubt: shorthand wording; the verifier concedes the string-plus-hook conversion is accurate.
Requirement inserts b_ENCODING_STRING after any existing or updated shebang, so the Ruby case should include the encoding line, not omit it.
Wrapper passes the link key only when not fallback and multiple key packets exist. Doubt: claim describes decryptSharePassphrase's optional-key contract accurately.
Records also include 'type', and some carry 'library_of_congress_name', so 'exactly code, name, key' leaves out fields.
Normalization doesn't always change PlayCount: one song with four plays stays 4; only some inputs, like 3 songs/6 plays, change.
The simplified GOST variant leaves the constant import unused, a compile error; the claim omits the needed import removal.
Requirement logs skipped collections at vvv verbosity only and explicitly says it is not a warning.
Text nodes inherit an empty childNodes NodeList. Doubt: agent meant no children, true, and itself indexes textNode.childNodes as undefined.
make_author is nested inside make_work, not a module-level function in addbook.py; wrong code location.
mypy.ini comments out --strict and several strict flags, and tox runs plain mypy; only a subset of strictness is active.
After required lowercasing, full names Tai and Vai equal known codes tai and vai, so the known-code check cannot distinguish them.
Requirement covers any existing or updated shebang; the added Python-only condition leaves out non-Python modules such as #!/usr/bin/ruby.
Neither the recalled conversion helper nor _normalize_language_name exists in baseline utils.py, which only has strip_accents and an inline normalizer.
Env-var argument transport works only within Linux environment size limits; large argument buffers hit E2BIG, so preservation is not guaranteed.
Sentinel preserving non-default Python shebangs skips the explicit ansible_python_interpreter lookup; an extra override branch is needed for precedence.
get_abbrev_from_full_lang_name does not exist in baseline; LanguageNoMatchError behavior is a new requirement, not existing code.
Requirement also covers Enter/Space keyboard activation of menu items calling the close handler, not just clicks.
'> 6' leaves exactly-six lists unsliced, showing six names. Doubt: 'truncated' implies exceeding; logic matches existing and upstream '> cutoff' behavior.
